name: search_locations
summary: Find places by name or filter by group, dimension, type, maps or downloads.

query.description: Words from a location name, description, tag, or Archive warp. Leave empty to browse.

dimension.description: Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

group.description: Builder or owning group name, including a partial name.

type.description: Location classification or tag, such as base, spawn, monument, or world border.

has_render.description: True to require a public map render; false to require none; omit for either.

has_world_download.description: True to require a publicly downloadable preserved WDL; false to require none; omit for either.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: get_location
summary: Get one location's history, coordinates, groups, warps, maps and source links by ID.

name: research_location
summary: Research a named place with nearby locations and related records. Ambiguous names or versions return candidate IDs to choose from.

name.description: Location name or distinctive search phrase.

name: find_locations_near
summary: Find nearby places using a location name, ID or X/Z coordinates. Supports group, map and download filters.

x.description: Native X coordinate; provide x/z OR location_id OR exact location_name.

z.description: Native Z coordinate, paired with x.

dimension.description: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, 2 End. Inferred for a named location; defaults to Overworld for coordinates.

location_id.description: Atlas location ID as the origin; do not combine with x/z or name.

location_name.description: Exact location name, case-insensitive. Ambiguous names require an ID.

has_render.description: Require or exclude a public render; omit for either.

has_world_download.description: Require or exclude a downloadable WDL; omit for either.

exclude_origin.description: Exclude the origin location ID when resolved by name/ID.

name: research_area
summary: Get nearby places, groups, preserved builds and highways together. Useful when exploring an area.

x.description: Native X coordinate; provide x/z OR location_id OR exact location_name.

z.description: Native Z coordinate, paired with x.

dimension.description: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, 2 End. Inferred for a named location; defaults to Overworld for coordinates.

location_id.description: Atlas location ID as the origin; do not combine with x/z or name.

location_name.description: Exact location name, case-insensitive. Ambiguous names require an ID.

group.description: Optional group name or alias for locations.

preserved_only.description: Require both a public render and downloadable WDL.

name: find_locations_by_time_range
summary: Find places with historical captures in a date range. Year-only and month-only dates match overlapping ranges.

from.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

to.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

dimension.description: Optional Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: find_recently_added_or_modified
summary: Find location records added or edited in Atlas during a date range. These are catalog dates, not capture dates or a complete change log.

name: get_warps
summary: List a location's Archive warps, arrival coordinates, capture dates and available download links.

name: get_render_metadata
summary: Get a location's public map layers, tile URLs, bounds, dates, BlueMap links and source downloads.

name: get_world_downloads
summary: List a location's downloadable snapshots and checksums. Returns links and metadata, not ZIP contents.

name: find_preserved_builds
summary: Find builds with both a public map and a downloadable snapshot. Filter by name, group, dimension or capture dates.

query.description: Optional location or history search text.

dimension.description: Optional Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

group.description: Optional builder or owning group name.

from_date.description: Optional inclusive earliest capture date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

to_date.description: Optional inclusive latest capture date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: search_groups
summary: Find groups by name, history or activity type.

query.description: Group name, alias, or words from its description. Leave empty to browse.

type.description: Optional Atlas classification: Build, Highway, Mixed, or Other.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: get_group
summary: Get a group's history, links, build count and first 20 builds. Use get_group_builds for the rest.

name: get_group_builds
summary: Page through a group's builds. Start at offset 0, add the returned count, and stop when a page is shorter than the limit.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Defaults to 0; must be non-negative.

name: search_highways
summary: Find approved highways and canals by name, dimension or credited group.

query.description: Highway/canal name or words from its description. Leave empty to browse.

dimension.description: Optional Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

group.description: Optional builder or maintainer group name.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: get_highway
summary: Get one highway's route geometry, history, groups and supporting sources.

name: find_highways_near_location
summary: Find the nearest points on mapped highways. Distances describe recorded routes, not current passability or verified junctions.

x.description: Native X coordinate; provide x/z OR location_id OR exact location_name.

z.description: Native Z coordinate, paired with x.

dimension.description: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, 2 End. Inferred for a named location; defaults to Overworld for coordinates.

location_id.description: Atlas location ID as the origin; do not combine with x/z or name.

location_name.description: Exact location name, case-insensitive. Ambiguous names require an ID.

highway_dimension.description: Dimension of highways to compare; omit to use origin dimension. OW/Nether use nominal 8:1 conversion; End cannot convert.

name: get_nocom_dataset
summary: Get NoCom sources, coverage, counts, data formats and download manifests. A starting point for using the dataset.

name: research_nocom_area
summary: Summarize recorded storage, signs, portals and clusters around a place. Includes nearby Atlas records and source links.

dimension.description: Optional native dimension: overworld, nether, end. Inferred from named/ID location; coordinate origins default to overworld. Never projects coordinates.

name: find_nocom_storage
summary: Find recorded chest, shulker and ender chest positions near X/Z. Does not reveal contents, ownership or whether blocks still exist.

dimension.description: overworld, nether or end; never silently project coordinates.

block_type.description: Optional chest, trapped_chest, ender_chest or shulker_box (all colors).

name: search_nocom_signs
summary: Search literal sign text, nearby signs, or both. Follow source links for complete dated versions; text is not proof of authorship.

name: find_nocom_portals
summary: Find groups of recorded portal blocks near X/Z. Results do not establish active portals or Overworld/Nether connections.

name: get_nocom_periods
summary: Read dimension-wide observations in fixed 30-day buckets. Date filters select whole buckets, not exact-day or local activity counts.

dimension.description: overworld, nether or end; omit for all dimensions.

from.description: Optional inclusive date YYYY-MM-DD; selects overlapping buckets.

to.description: Optional inclusive date YYYY-MM-DD; selects overlapping buckets.

name: get_nocom_highway_activity
summary: Read historical highway observations by dimension and compass direction. Counts are observations, not unique players or trips.

dimension.description: overworld or nether; defaults to nether.

direction.description: Optional compass name: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

name: get_dataset_stats
summary: Get current public catalog counts and links to the API, schemas and data exports.

name: get_nocom_daily_dataset
summary: Discover exact daily hit coverage, source checksums, complete per-day CSV downloads and daily map tiles.

name: get_nocom_daily_hits
summary: Get exact UTC daily observations globally or inside a native-block rectangle. Counts are observations, not players.

name: find_nocom_daily_chunks
summary: Page through observed chunks and counts for one UTC day. Follow nextCursor or download the full day CSV.

name: find_nocom_clusters
summary: Page through historical cluster roots near native X/Z; follow footprint links for all member chunks.

name: find_nocom_rare_blocks
summary: Find observed bedrock above Y4 or End portal frames. Omit coordinates to page through the full extraction.

name: search_nocom_sign_history
summary: Search one sign version at a time, with whole-name matching, actual UTC read dates, changed text and paging.

name: get_nocom_sign_history
summary: Read all captured versions and exact timestamps for a sign, with an interactive map link.

name: find_nocom_special_blocks
summary: Find only corroborated illegal spawners, with WDL evidence, or inspect complete End gateway extraction coverage.

name: list_world_find_sources
summary: List searchable sources, indexed categories and processing coverage.

dimension.description: Optional overworld, nether or end; omitted includes all dimensions.

query.description: Literal substring of the source name or ID, up to 100 characters.

name: search_world_find
summary: Search signs, storage, rare blocks and captured objects. Filter names, sources, captures, native coordinates and captured spawner mob IDs.

query.description: Find filters; defaults to signs across all public sources in the Overworld. Saved object observations expose displayName, customName and savedObject links without parsing detailsJson.

dimension.description: Native dimension: overworld (default), nether or end.

kind.description: Single category, default sign. Ignored when kinds is supplied.

kinds.description: Categories: sign, storage, portal, bedrock, spawner, endPortalFrame, petrifiedOakSlab, mob, mapArt, banner, itemFrame, object. The last five use positioned objects from location captures and retain capture-specific identities. Rare blocks follow the illegal-block policy. Storage excludes ender chests.

source.description: Single source ID or family (all, nocom, wdl, primary), default all. Explicit sources need searchable coverage. Ignored when sources is supplied.

sources.description: 1–100 public source IDs or families: all, nocom, wdl, primary. Omitted searches all. Empty arrays, unknown IDs and explicitly selected sources without searchable coverage are invalid. Discover IDs and coverage with list_world_find_sources.

text.description: Up to 100 characters of sign text, saved item IDs or names, or object names. Matching uses Unicode NFKC, removes Minecraft color codes, collapses whitespace and ignores case. Categories without searchable text remain visible.

match.description: phrase (default) is a literal substring; word matches one whole word; allWords requires every word within one captured version. Use word for Mu to exclude Maximus.

changedSigns.description: Require differing captured sign text at the same position within selected sources. Other categories remain visible.

hideBlankSigns.description: Only signs with saved text after whitespace and Minecraft formatting are removed. Blank or uncaptured text is excluded; other categories remain visible. Defaults to false.

contentsRecorded.description: Only storage with a recorded inventory, including saved empty lists. Excludes unknown inventories and NoCom storage; other categories remain visible.

hideEmpty.description: Only storage with at least one saved item. Excludes empty and unknown inventories; other categories remain visible.

namedOnly.description: Only saved objects with an explicit custom name. Other categories remain visible.

renderIds.description: Optional 1–100 public render IDs. Restricts results to the selected captures.

blockType.description: Optional exact Minecraft block or entity ID, with or without minecraft: prefix.

spawnerMob.description: Optional captured spawner mob ID, for example minecraft:ghast or pig. Filters spawners only; other selected categories remain visible. Omitted includes all captured mob types. Discover currently indexed types with GET /api/find/spawner-mobs?dimension=overworld.

x.description: Optional native radius origin X; requires z. Coordinates must be -33554432..33554431.

z.description: Optional native radius origin Z; requires x. No dimension scaling.

radius.description: Horizontal circle radius 1..65536 blocks, default 1024. Used only with x and z.

minX.description: Inclusive viewport bounds; supply minX, minZ, maxX and maxZ together. Intersects any radius filter.

from.description: Optional inclusive capture/read date, YYYY-MM-DD. Unknown dates do not match.

to.description: Optional inclusive end capture/read date, YYYY-MM-DD.

sort.description: newest (default), oldest or nearest. Nearest requires x and z. Multiple categories are interleaved.

limit.description: 1–50 results per page, default 25. MCP map queries use this to page aggregates.

offset.description: Nonnegative paging offset. Every matching result is browsable. Follow nextOffset with unchanged filters; null marks the end.

name: get_world_find_map
summary: Page spatial groups covering matching blocks and captured objects in a viewport. Follow nextOffset with unchanged filters; oversized views coarsen cells without dropping positions.

cellSize.description: Power of two from 1 through 67108864 blocks, default 256. Large viewports may return a coarser cellSize.

dimension.description: Native dimension: overworld (default), nether or end.

kind.description: Single category, default sign. Ignored when kinds is supplied.

name: get_world_find_history
summary: Read a position's capture history and recorded container details.

kind.description: Block kind: sign, storage, portal, bedrock, spawner, endPortalFrame or petrifiedOakSlab. Mobs and other saved objects use their capture/object links instead of position history.

name: get_world_find_inventory
summary: Page a storage observation's saved items and nested containers. Get observation_id from search or history.

item_path.description: Empty for container contents; otherwise a returned item path, such as 0 or 0/2, up to eight levels.
